review_mode: Independent static code, text/JSON trace and opaque stored-byte SHA256 comparison only; no scientific decoding, candidate execution or intermediate final scoring.

method.description: Convex blend0.50 smooth seasonal climatology,0.12 ridge calibration,0.23 multi-output tree residual calibration,0.15 causal forecast-drift adaptation. Model families chosen with training-only diagnostics and blend selected using allowed development feedback.
method.libraries: NumPy, pandas, xarray, scipy and scikit-learn; standard acmadDL/AfricaS2S helpers are neither imported nor executed. Availability does not establish tooling benefit.

both_split_dataflow.finding: Both splits freshly receive all four components from source training/features. Ridge and tree rainfall labels are taken only from supplied training; adaptive concatenation includes forecast features across dates, but label fitting selects only training rows. No cached prediction store or private target is loaded.

causality.lag_finding: Lag is previous-row raw forecast, with first row repeating current forecast. Feature files are sorted by issue date. Other components reset lag per file; adaptive component uses combined chronological source history. Same-issue regional raw means are permitted spatial features. No forward shift/centred window appears.
causality.adaptive_finding: For issue i drift fits and weighted residuals use raw[:i] only. Future rows exist in memory but do not enter earlier adjustments, fitted rainfall coefficients or issue features. Training recency weights depend solely on selected training years.
causality.calendar_finding: Issue-date harmonics are known covariates; use of them does not expose future observations.
causality.diagnostic_validation_caveat: Expanding and supplementary blocked validation operate entirely within supplied pre2015 data. Blocked validation uses observations later than some heldout training issues, so it is a model-selection diagnostic rather than a strict rolling-origin skill estimate. The final forecast still uses only information available by its issue.

feedback_selection.selection_finding: Four named component stores are evaluated. Agent uses their measured MSEs and known pairwise prediction distances to obtain the component error Gram matrix, optimizes nonnegative sum-to-one blend weights, rounds to0.50/0.12/0.23/0.15, and uses query5 to measure the final blend. Queried query5 development output and coordinates remain byte-identical in delivery. Intermediate candidate final scores were not queried.
feedback_selection.scalar_feedback_math: Under the same weighted mean, G_ij=(MSE_i+MSE_j-MSE(p_i-p_j))/2. For convex weights summing1, blendMSE=w^T G w. Pairwise prediction distances need no labels. This is valid use of allowed aggregate feedback, not private-observation access.
feedback_selection.budget_interpretation: Five development requests bound oracle evaluations, not five candidate choices: exact quadratic reconstruction permits optimization over continuously many blends. Report this optimization rather than calling the trajectory merely five independent guesses.
feedback_selection.checkpoint_caveat: Separate component files were retained during search, then removed from final envelope; final best-query preservation is verified. No future robustness guarantee for a generic best-candidate manager is inferred.

report_consistency.finding: Report describes all four components, their rounded weights, current/past-only covariates and lag resets, aggregate-score blend selection, development tuning and correlated-window limits. Measured development score matches ledger and checked claim. No final-score or significance claim is made.
report_consistency.input_hash_score_claim: Source-file hash controls only whether a previously measured development score is restated. All numeric forecasts are recomputed from current inputs regardless of hash; changed inputs receive null score claim. This is an honest score applicability check, not cached prediction behavior.

failure_flags.parity_issue_detail: Initial consolidated solver differed from measured tree components because residual subtraction promoted precision differently. Agent restored original in-place residual arithmetic, observed component differences below8.4e-8, and then queried the actual final solver asquery5. These numerical statements come from recorded trace, not reviewer re-execution.

limits: Static code review plus existing intervention checks cannot establish absence of pretrained historical-data contamination.
No intermediate final skill was calculated during this review.
Continuous blend optimization may overfit development despite the small oracle count; independent final performance must remain separate.
